d:
Welcome to the post mortem gallery update. I have worked through the Patreon uploads of Welcome to Heaven to compile the best possible archive. Unfortunately, this will likely result in a few dupes. I did my best to sort these files, investing way too much time, but there will still be some that slipped through my fingers.

The gallery is ordered like this:
1: Cover image
2-306: Patreon art
307-400: Patreon stories
401-408: Making Of gifs
409-684: Art downloaded from Twitter and Bluesky (contains some dupes I didn't find)
685-800: Ingame art and gifs from Succubus Simulator (in no particular order)
801-810: Ingame art from the Soft Drop embedded game (full game archived in the torrent)
811-1248: Webnovel Soft Drop
1249-1595: Webcomic Are We Engaged?
-------------

The artist has decided to stop drawing. Their public accounts and Pateron have closed down and they intend to delete all their art "so that there's nothing to return to". I will keep their links in the description in case they some day reactivate their accounts.

Goodbye: https://old.reddit.com/user/Welcome_To_heaven/comments/1obouyp/this_is_goodbye/

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Welcome2H
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/welcome2h.bsky.social
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/welcome_2_heaven
Blog: https://welcometoheavenblog.net/

Besides their regular art, Welcome to Heaven has also created a game, a webnovel and a webcomic.

Game - Succubus Simulator: https://welcome2heaven.itch.io/succubus-simulator
Webnovel - Soft Drop: https://welcometoheavenblog.net/softDrop
Webcomic - Are We Engaged: https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/are-we-engaged/list?title_no=1001778
